visualCharacteristics.notes: Large rounded image cards with dark bottom gradient and white eyebrow/title/link overlaid bottom-left; the whole card is linked.

contentPattern.structure: per card: image | optional eyebrow paragraph + heading (e.g. h4) + link (makes the whole card clickable)

suitableFor: image navigation tiles with overlaid titles
notSuitableFor: image-top cards with text below (use cards-promo)
